_comment: Copy, edit, and pass with --request. Timing is driven by hand-authored narration: list the audio segments and the Editor cuts the script to fit their measured durations. Omit `audio` (or set it to null) and the Editor falls back to a chars-per-second estimate, which the render stage marks as unmeasured.

sampling_hint.note: The Generator declares its own spec and filter; this is only a starting range. A presentation filter may constrain rendered width, sign, and zero — nothing else. See pipeline/lib/sampling.mjs.
